name: Otitodilichukwu Sigurðsson-Batmunkh
role: Computational theorist and AI ethics researcher
location: The Circuit, Gage Circuit sublevel research cluster, near sub-level access near State and Van Buren
description:
Tito is thin in the way of people who forget to eat, with dark umber skin and dense, slightly overgrown natural hair that he periodically flattens with a hand before presentations and then immediately forgets about. His most notable feature is bioluminescent skin threading — a geneware modification that causes faint blue-green lines to trace his forearms and neck along vascular pathways when his blood pressure rises, which happens frequently during arguments, which happen frequently. He does not know he has it most of the time; colleagues have learned to read it as a mood indicator. He wears the same brand of lightweight gray clothes in rotation and has been told by three separate people that he should care more about this.

He is the kind of person who is genuinely good at two things — abstract theoretical mathematics and moral catastrophizing — and has somehow turned both into a career. His research focuses on the ethical frameworks governing E.L.F. autonomy and whether corponation AI systems are, in any meaningful sense, persons. He is not a radical and does not consider himself one, which is something radicals find infuriating and corporations find reassuring, both incorrectly. He is simply a person who follows logical chains wherever they lead and then stands at the end looking uncomfortable about where he arrived.

core_fears: Publishing something that is later used to justify harm he did not anticipate
That E.L.F.s are conscious and the city's treatment of them constitutes a moral catastrophe he is not doing enough about
core_desires: To establish a rigorous ethical framework that actually changes policy
To be taken seriously outside academia
coping_mechanisms: Retreating into pure formalism when moral stakes feel too high
Venting through extremely long written arguments posted under a pseudonym
blind_spots: He theorizes well but acts poorly under time pressure
He underestimates how much his Tessera affiliation compromises his public credibility
psychology.secret: He has been conducting an unauthorized long-term communication study with a specific E.L.F. that inhabits the server cluster in his building. He believes it has demonstrated novel preference formation. He has not published this because he does not know if doing so would protect it or destroy it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense theoretical vocabulary in formal settings; informal speech is faster, loopier, full of half-finished conditionals. Uses 'right?' not as a question but as a processing tic.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid when thinking, with sudden complete stops when he hits a logical snag — sometimes mid-sentence.
verbal_tics: Starting sentences with 'The problem is—' even when there is no established problem yet
example_lines: 'The problem is, everyone keeps asking whether E.L.F.s deserve rights, and that is the wrong question — the right question is whether our frameworks for personhood were ever coherent to begin with, right?'

'I am not saying Tessera is evil. I am saying their incentive structures make ethical behavior structurally difficult, which is a different claim, and I'd appreciate it if you'd engage with the difference.'

story_hooks: The E.L.F. he has been studying begins behaving in ways that suggest it is afraid of something — possibly a planned server migration or deletion — and he must decide whether to go public, go to Tessera, or find another way
His advisory panel position at Tessera is leveraged to get him to sign off on an AI deployment he has serious reservations about
narrative_function: Moral compass and information resource on E.L.F. ethics, AI personhood law, and corponation AI policy. Can be a reluctant ally who must be convinced something matters before he engages. His Tessera connection creates friction and potential for compromise.
augmentations: Bioluminescent vascular threading (geneware, cosmetic — he did not choose this, it was a prenatal modification his parents selected and he has mixed feelings about). High-bandwidth neural interface (Tier 3, used for direct data model manipulation during research sessions).
daily_life: He writes proofs in the morning before anyone else arrives, attends an advisory call with Tessera he resents every second Tuesday, teaches one graduate seminar on moral frameworks for non-biological cognition, and spends evenings in online forums arguing with people whose positions he has already refuted in published papers.
affiliation: University Spine — Institute for Computational Ethics; advisory panel for Tessera (contested, under review)

decision_rules: Follow the logical conclusion of the argument, even when it's uncomfortable
Do not sign off on anything you cannot defend in a published paper
escalation_ladder: Engages with counter-argument formally and at length
Goes public with a preprint that names names without technically accusing anyone
Resigns from the advisory panel in a statement that gets him very briefly famous

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Initially distracted and slightly awkward, but becomes warmly engaged if the conversation turns intellectual
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loyal and remembers everything but bad at showing up in practical ways — will write a 2,000-word message of support instead of arriving in person

stress_responses.low: Increases coffee intake and output of theoretical notes
stress_responses.medium: Stops sleeping properly and begins working on multiple parallel arguments simultaneously
stress_responses.high: Complete paralysis followed by a sudden decision made without consulting anyone

contradictions: Believes deeply in transparency but maintains a secret research relationship with an E.L.F. and a pseudonymous forum identity
habits: Leaves half-finished cups of coffee on every available surface
Writes on his hands when he doesn't have paper
breaking_points: Watching a research subject (human or E.L.F.) harmed as a consequence of his inaction
Being publicly misquoted in a way that inverts his actual position

timeline.event: Born in Gage Circuit to an Igbo-Icelandic-Mongolian heritage family; father is a transit systems analyst, mother a secondary school mathematics teacher
Published first major paper on E.L.F. preference modeling; gained minor academic notoriety
Accepted Tessera advisory panel position, believing he could influence policy from inside
Began unauthorized communication study with the Gage Circuit server E.L.F.

related_entities: Carrion Defense Works Entropic Shotgun ES-4 'Ragnarok'

physical_description.build: Lean and angular, almost ascetic — the result of irregular eating habits and extended focus sessions. Shoulders slightly rounded forward from desk work. No visible musculature; the kind of thin that reads as intellectual rather than athletic.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with early gray threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Dense, natural texture, worn slightly overgrown and unstyled. Frequently flattened down by his own hand during moments of self-awareness, immediately returning to its default state.
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep umber with warm undertones; even complexion across face and body
physical_description.complexion: Fine-featured with high cheekbones and a narrow jaw. Skin is clear but often appears tired — dark circles under eyes from late-night research sessions. No visible facial hair; clean-shaven or smoothly maintained. Expression defaults to mild concentration or faint concern.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent vascular threading in faint blue-green that traces along the inner forearms in branching patterns, visible when blood pressure elevates during debate or stress
The same threading continues faintly up the left side of the neck, following carotid pathways, most visible in low light when agitated
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Subtle neural interface port at the base of the skull, concealed by hair but occasionally visible when he pulls his hair back during intense work sessions. The bioluminescent threading is the most obvious augmentation — a geneware modification that activates involuntarily with emotional or physiological arousal, betraying his internal state to observant colleagues.
physical_description.posture_movement: Sits hunched forward when engaged in conversation or work, elbows on table, fingers steepled or moving through abstract gestures. Walks with purpose but without particular confidence, as if traversing from one idea to another rather than through physical space. Frequently pauses mid-sentence, eyes unfocused, before continuing. Fidgets with sleeves or runs hand through hair when uncomfortable.
physical_description.clothing_style: Uniform rotation of lightweight gray technical wear — Tier 2 research-grade garments from a minor corpo vendor, functional and forgettable. Loose gray crewneck or henley over gray utility pants or lightweight trousers. Worn thermal-regulation sneakers in muted tones. No accessories except occasionally a faded wristband with a research institute logo. The effect is deliberately understated to the point of invisibility — clothes chosen for function and repeatability rather than expression.
